workflow: Built-in image_gen was used for discarded visual drafts. Final production textures use only user-authorized deterministic Python and original diffuse pixels. No fallback API/CLI used.
initial_prompts:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 3D material DATA texture, txMaps for Assetto Corsa ksPerPixelMultiMap. Input image 1 is the edit target: a 4096x2048 face diffuse UV atlas. Transform it into ONE RGB packed specular/gloss/reflection map, 2:1 landscape, requested 4096x2048 pixels. Preserve pixel-normalized UV layout exactly: eye centers around (0.302,0.444) and (0.698,0.444), nose tip (0.501,0.662), mouth center (0.503,0.89), forehead above y .30, skin boundary silhouette unchanged. No crop, no reposition, no perspective, no zoom, no UV reshaping.
This is not a coloured face photo. Every output RGB pixel encodes independent material data: R specular intensity, G gloss/sharpness multiplier, B environment-reflection intensity. Alpha fully opaque. Human face slightly moist with sweat film, localized small nose-tip sheen, no large droplets. Base dry cheeks RGB approximately (64,55,5). Forehead gradual moderate oil RGB (96,92,8). Nose tip and nose bridge soft anatomically localized RGB (145,165,12), tiny peak on nose tip RGB (165,190,15). Outer dry skin RGB (64,60,5). Soft graduated transitions, low-amplitude pore detail consistent with diffuse. Lips around (95,105,7). Eyebrows/hair RGB (18,32,1). Nostril hollows RGB (12,24,1). Keep iris/eyeball reflectivity subdued around RGB (60,95,5), do not bake photographed reflections. Outside facial UV island fill a uniform neutral low-sheen skin-material data value (64,60,5), not black; gently extend nearby values just outside silhouette to prevent edge seams. Output should look olive/muted yellow-green with brighter green only on T-zone, almost no blue. No diffuse/albedo coloration, no shadows, no illumination, no rendered highlights, no text, no grids, no watermark, no border. This image must match the source face layout for application to the same UV atlas.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 3D material DATA texture, DirectX tangent-space txNormal for Assetto Corsa ksPerPixelMultiMap. Input image 1 is the edit target: 4096x2048 face diffuse UV atlas. Convert it into ONE tangent-space RGB normal map, 2:1 landscape, requested 4096x2048 pixels. Preserve exact normalized UV positions and scale: eye centers (0.302,.444),(.698,.444), nose tip (.501,.662), mouth (.503,.89), entire original facial silhouette unchanged. No crop, zoom, reframing, perspective, island movement or changed facial feature proportions.
Normals ONLY, purple-blue data encoding. Neutral tangent surface RGB(128,128,255); +X red, DirectX -Y green convention. Skin is subtle living human skin: very fine shallow pores, gentle small crow-foot and forehead fine wrinkles, restrained micro grooves on lips, tiny thin eyebrow hair relief. Mild sweat film smooths microdetail on nose tip and nose bridge, slightly on forehead; no sweat droplets, no cratered pores, no coarse orange-peel. Most skin R/G remain close to 128, typically 120-136; B close to 250-255. Encode very shallow microrelief in correct derivative colours, not photographic grayscale shading. DO NOT encode the large nose, cheek, eye-socket or face geometry as a raised full face: these shapes already exist in the mesh. No dark albedo pores, no skin pigmentation, no photographed lighting, no highlights, no diffuse colour, no AO. Eyes mostly flat neutral; no raised iris, no eye reflection markings. Blend remaining skin macro forms to neutral, with fine detail only. Outside face silhouette neutral RGB(128,128,255) with gentle neutral transition at edge; fully opaque alpha. Output only the complete single normal texture without labels, legend, grids, watermark or frame.
revised_prompts: Edit image 2; image 1 is original face UV layout reference. Create a corrected technical RGB txMaps DATA MASK. Keep the exact whole face UV layout and 2:1 aspect of image 1. Requested pixel size 2048x1024. REMOVE all photographic shading and highlights in image 2: no nose sculpting shading, no lit pores, no dark socket shadows, no large highlight on forehead. THIS MUST LOOK LIKE A FLAT COLOUR-CODED MATERIAL MASK, NOT A FACE RENDER: only subtle region boundaries and subtle texture. Base skin AND outer padding exact RGB (64,55,4), an almost uniform dark muted olive. Smooth forehead region RGB (85,90,6). Small nose-tip and narrow bridge region RGB (145,165,10), brighter green than base, without white specular dots. Lip region (90,95,5). Eyebrow hair region (20,32,0). Nostril opening region (14,24,0). Eyes muted (55,85,4). The pixels contain RED specular intensity, GREEN gloss/sharpness, BLUE tiny cubemap reflection intensity. Blue MUST BE between 0 and 12 EVERYWHERE, never add RGB grey shading. Alpha fully opaque. Pore-level material variation maximum +/-3 per channel, not high-contrast lighting or noise. Preserve face feature locations and cutout shape of reference 1 without rendering its geometry. Entire outside-UV backdrop uniform RGB(64,55,4), no vignette or gradient. No text. Output only flat RGB packed mask.

Edit image 2, keeping face layout matching original image 1. This is a DirectX tangent-space NORMAL DATA texture, not illustration. Preserve EXACT UV alignment, relative feature positions and complete face shape with 2:1 canvas. Requested size 2048x1024. The first normal is much too strong. Reduce ALL red/green vector deviations from RGB(128,128,255) by about 75 percent. Fill outer background exactly (128,128,255). Remove broad nose bulge, socket/nostril depth, face contours and eyeball shapes: macrogeometry is in mesh. Keep only very shallow fine pores and fine lines on cheeks/forehead, thin eyebrow hair and fine lip grooves. Nose/bridge smoother still. Eyes flat exactly (128,128,255). Skin R/G mainly 124-132, at strongest fine lines 118-138; B mostly 253-255. Flat near-neutral purple-blue appearance, face barely perceptible at thumbnail size, slight finer microstructure only at close inspection. No dark cavities, no embossed cutout boundary, no extreme cyan/magenta, no photographic lighting, no colour shading, no AO, no gradients representing face shape. DirectX -Y convention. Fully opaque. Output only the complete subtle normal map, no labels or other items.
reason_discarded: UV invariance and numeric packed-channel targets were not guaranteed. Draft pixels are not included in final PNG/DDS.
